description.content: Local or isolated Git worktree sessions, Codex-compatible default setup scripts, setup progress, workspace file previews and read-only Git diffs with submodule support. Archiving removes idle plugin-owned worktrees without snapshots, including uncommitted and ignored files, while preserving branches. No npm publication is required; public GitHub source is available.
为 DSH 提供本地/隔离工作树选择、Codex 默认 setup 配置兼容、初始化进度，以及工作区文件预览和子模块只读 Git Diff。归档时清理空闲且归属可核验的工作树，保留分支；不创建快照，未提交与 ignored 文件会删除，请先提交成果。通过公开 GitHub 仓库分发。
